full_prompt_en: A square gritty graphic illustration shows a single masked figure from the waist upward against an almost entirely black background, rendered in dusty crimson and rough charcoal. The background has no identifiable setting; only a faint smoky brown haze lifts from the lower left, and the dark upper space isolates the head. The figure stands slightly right of center, angled toward the left. Its head is encased in an elaborate gas-mask-like shell with round dark lenses, a circular filter at the mouth, and raised spiky protrusions along the crown. Engraved mechanical details, scratches, and layered plates crowd the surface of the mask, hiding every human facial feature. A high red collar surrounds the neck. Below it, a heavy red coat with broad shoulders, thick seams, pockets, and folds fills the right side and lower half. Black and darker red marks describe the weight of wrinkled fabric without smoothing it into a photographic surface. On the left, a gloved hand grips the end of a ribbed cylindrical object. A thick coiled hose loops in front of the wrist and disappears into the lower edge, adding a ring-shaped accent against the coat. The image is tightly cropped around the figure; no ground or other person is visible. Light comes from the upper left, catching the crown spikes, rim of the eye lens, raised coat folds, and glove, while the recesses of the mask and underside of the collar sink into black. Red paint is uneven and grainy, with scratch-like lines making the highlights tactile. There is no readable text. The overall composition is ominous and compact, using a pale red mechanical head and rough crimson clothing as a single angular mass against enveloping darkness.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形粗粝图形插画呈现一位蒙面的单独人物，从腰部向上入画，背景几乎全黑，画面由灰红与粗涩炭黑绘成。背景没有可辨地点；只有一丝烟状棕雾从左下升起，深色上部空间将头部隔离出来。人物站在中央偏右，身体朝左。头部被复杂的防毒面具般外壳包住，带有圆形深色目镜、口部圆形过滤器，以及头顶凸起的尖刺。雕刻般机械细节、刮痕和层叠板件挤在面具表面，完全藏住人的五官。高高的红色衣领围住脖颈。下方厚重红外套有宽肩、粗缝线、口袋和褶皱，填满右侧与下半部。黑色及更深红色笔痕描述起皱布料的重量，没有把它抹成摄影般平滑表面。左侧戴手套的手握着一根带肋纹的圆柱状物体末端。粗线缆在手腕前盘成一圈，又从下缘消失，在外套前形成环形重音。画面紧贴人物裁切；看不到地面或其他人。光从左上照来，落在头顶尖刺、目镜边圈、隆起的外套褶皱和手套上，面具凹处与衣领底面则沉入黑色。红色颜料不匀且带颗粒，刮痕般线条让高光可触。没有可读文字。整体构图不安而紧凑，以浅红机械头部与粗涩绯红衣着构成单一棱角大形，对抗包围的黑暗。
style_prompt_en: The gritty graphic treatment pits a restricted dusty-red range against near-total black. Surface detail is built from scratched contour lines, dense crosshatching, grain, and irregular blocks of opaque pigment, giving even broad forms a worn physical texture. Circular openings and hard spikes interrupt thick folded volumes, producing a rhythm of mechanical precision inside rough brushwork. Light is narrow and directional, catching raised rims and angular edges while allowing interiors to close into black. The main mass is large and tightly cropped, and negative space around its upper edge makes the silhouette feel isolated and imposing. Red varies through pale salmon highlights, crimson midtones, and almost black shadow rather than through a broad palette. Edges can be sharp at a focal rim and frayed across textured surfaces. The overall effect is abrasive, dark, and graphic, with material decay and compressed tonal contrast carrying the impact.
style_prompt_zh: 这种粗粝图形处理让受限制的灰红色域面对近乎完全的黑色。表面细节由刮擦轮廓线、密集交叉排线、颗粒和不规则不透明色块建立，使宽阔形体也带磨旧的实体肌理。圆形开口与坚硬尖形打断厚重褶叠体积，在粗涩笔触中形成机械精度的节奏。光线狭窄而有方向性，只照亮凸起边圈与棱角边缘，让内部合拢成黑暗。主要大形体量大且裁切紧密，周围上缘的负空间又使剪影显得孤立而压迫。红色在浅鲑色高光、绯红中间调与近黑阴影之间变化，而非依赖宽广配色。边缘可在焦点边圈处锐利，在有肌理表面上却磨散。整体效果粗砺、幽暗且图形鲜明，材料磨损和压缩明暗反差承担冲击力。

theme_zh: 红衣面具人物手握盘绕线缆，立于黑色背景前
